Paneer Tikka is a popular Indian appetizer consisting of cubes of paneer (Indian cottage cheese) marinated in a spiced yogurt mixture and then grilled or baked. It is a vegetarian alternative to chicken tikka and other meat dishes. The marinade typically includes yogurt, spices like turmeric, red chili powder, and garam masala. The grilled paneer often has a smoky, slightly charred exterior and a juicy, flavorful inside. It is commonly served with mint chutney or green chutney.
